title: What is Internee.pk?
content: Internee.pk is a platform that connects Pakistani students with internship opportunities to gain practical experience in their field of study.

title: Reporting time kya hai?
content: Reporting time is 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Monday to Friday). Weekends are off unless specified otherwise by your mentor.

title: Dress code kya hai?
content: Dress code is smart casual. Formal wear is not required but we expect professional and decent attire during working hours.

title: Stipend kab aayega?
content: Stipends are disbursed on the 1st of every month for the previous month. If the 1st falls on a weekend, it is processed on the next working day. For any delays, please contact HR at hr@internee.pk.

title: Leave lena hai — process kya hai?
content: To apply for leave: 1) Inform your mentor at least 1 day in advance. 2) Submit a leave application via the portal. 3) Wait for approval. For sick leave, inform your mentor before reporting time on the same day.

title: Certificate kab mile ga?
content: Internship completion certificates are issued within 7 working days after your internship end date and successful submission of all pending tasks.

title: Attendance kaise mark karein?
content: Attendance is marked through the Internee.pk portal. Login to your account and click on 'Mark Attendance' button. Make sure to mark attendance within the first 30 minutes of reporting time.

title: What is the probation period?
content: The probation period for interns is 2 weeks. During this time, your performance will be evaluated by your mentor. Successful completion of probation confirms your internship.
